The background consists of a vast expanse of water, likely an ocean or sea, with a few faint lines that could represent waves or ripples on the surface. The jet itself is sleek and modern, with a pointed nose and a streamlined body. It has two wings extending outward, each equipped with what appear to be engines or missile launchers.
